asset_type: Original transparent illustration for Koko's sign-in transition
subject: Two friendly interlocking speech bubbles, one pale mint #B9EDCE at upper left, one warm ivory #F2F1E6 at lower right, gently leaning toward one another. Each has a short sculptural speech tail. The mint bubble contains two small forest-green dots, the ivory bubble three small forest-green dots. One fine sage-green loose ribbon weaves behind the bubbles, one tiny muted butter-yellow four-point glint at upper right.
style: Contemporary editorial cut-paper illustration for a refined adult social app. Clean graphic silhouettes, subtle paper grain, slight layered depth, restrained friendly irregularity. Tasteful, compact, warm, not childish. No glossy plastic or glass, no neon glow, no heavy drop shadow. A real illustrated social motif, not a standard icon copied from an icon library.
composition: Square canvas, centered compact composition occupying central 80%, ample TRANSPARENT padding. All bubbles fully opaque and ribbon details visible. Designed to sit against solid dark forest #132A26 UI and be displayed at 190 points.
text: NO text, letters, words, logos or watermark.
constraints: Genuine alpha transparency outside the artwork. No backdrop card, no background color, no white rectangular panel. Just the two original conversation shapes, ribbon, subtle glint. No device mockup.
